title: Pause before you click
tip: Check the sender and destination carefully. Unexpected urgency, payment changes, and requests for sign-in codes deserve extra scrutiny.
task: Report a suspicious message through your organization’s approved channel; do not forward it widely.

title: Protect sign-in
tip: Use MFA where available. Never approve a prompt you did not initiate and never share a one-time code.
task: Review MFA methods on one important account.

title: Keep software current
tip: Updates fix known weaknesses. Restart when required and use your organization’s managed update process.
task: Check whether automatic updates are enabled on your browser.

title: Use unique passphrases
tip: Unique credentials limit the damage when one service is exposed. A reputable password manager can help.
task: Replace one reused password with a unique generated password.

title: Handle attachments safely
tip: Unexpected attachments can be risky even when the display name looks familiar. Verify through a separate trusted channel.
task: Review your process for reporting an unexpected attachment.

title: Share data carefully
tip: Share only information needed for the task, with approved recipients and storage locations.
task: Check the audience before sharing your next document.

title: Report early
tip: A mistaken click or unusual prompt is a reason to ask for help promptly; early reporting supports response.
task: Find your help desk or incident reporting contact.
